title: rpg maker xp limitation? skip empty control variables

posts.author: NaMosca
posts.body:
Hey guys when I was creating a alchemy system from this guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1252321481
I noticed that if I allocate the variable control values to the last variables of event control variables, skipping several blank variables, the system does not work. So I allocated them to the previous blank variables and it worked. Did you know about this problem?

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
It's very hard to try to understand your setup just from you talking about it.
Please post screenshots of your actual event and describe which parts aren't working.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
no, but it might be something else.
did you use leading zeroes in your script commands?
because in script commands you must NEVER use leading zeroes.
the command would need to be for example
$game_variables(20)=@item.id
it can never be $game_variables(0020)
That is because in programming, 00 is the key for octal numbers, and octal 20 is decimal 16 - it will point to the wrong variables if you use leading zeroes. Only 1 to 8 are identical in decimal and octal, higher numbers are not.
